words.sanskrit: devah ha vai prajapatim abruvan ka sita kim rupam iti

meaning.en: the gods asked Prajapati, who is Sita, what is her form
meaning.hi: देवताओं ने प्रजापति से पूछा, सीता कौन, उसका रूप क्या

words.sanskrit: sa hovacha prajapatih sa sita iti

meaning.en: Prajapati answered, she herself is Sita
meaning.hi: प्रजापति ने कहा, वह स्वयं सीता है

meaning.en: as root-nature, she is remembered as Sita, nature itself
meaning.hi: मूल-प्रकृति होने से वह सीता, प्रकृति स्मृत

meaning.en: as the nature within Om, she is called Sita
meaning.hi: प्रणव-प्रकृति होने से वह सीता कही जाती है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: sita iti trivarna-atma sakshat mayamayi bhavet

meaning.en: the name Sita is three syllables, illusion given living form
meaning.hi: सीता तीन अक्षर, साक्षात् मायामयी

words.sanskrit: vishnuh prapancha-bijam cha maya ikarah uchyate

meaning.en: Vishnu is the seed of the world, the syllable I is that illusion
meaning.hi: विष्णु प्रपंच-बीज, ईकार माया

words.sanskrit: sakarah satyam amritam praptih somah cha kirtyate

meaning.en: the syllable S is truth, nectar of immortality, and the moon
meaning.hi: सकार सत्य, अमृत, सोम

words.sanskrit: takarah tara-lakshmya cha vairajah prastarah smritah

meaning.en: the syllable T is Tara-Lakshmi's radiance and the path to the highest realm
meaning.hi: तकार तारा-लक्ष्मी, वैराज-पथ

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: in I's form, she carries Soma's limbs and nectar, adorned with divine ornaments and pearls
meaning.hi: ईकार-रूपिणी, सोम-अमृत, दिव्य आभूषण-मुक्ता से अलंकृत

meaning.en: the great illusion, formless, becomes visible
meaning.hi: महामाया अव्यक्त-रूपिणी व्यक्त होती है

words.sanskrit: prathama shabda-brahmamayi svadhyaya-kale prasanna udbhavanakari satmika

meaning.en: her first aspect, made of sacred sound, appears joyfully in self-study
meaning.hi: पहली, शब्दब्रह्ममयी, स्वाध्याय में प्रकट

meaning.en: her second aspect arises from the earth at the plow's tip
meaning.hi: दूसरी, हल की नोक पर उत्पन्न

words.sanskrit: tritiya ikara-rupini avyakta-svarupa bhavati iti sita ityudaharanti

meaning.en: her third aspect, formless, is what people mean by the name Sita
meaning.hi: तीसरी, अव्यक्त-स्वरूपा, यही सीता कही जाती है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: as the Shaunakiya text says, through Rama's nearness she delights the whole world
meaning.hi: शौनकीय में, राम की निकटता से जगत-आनंदकारिणी

meaning.en: she causes birth, continued life, and end of every embodied being
meaning.hi: समस्त देहियों की उत्पत्ति-स्थिति-संहारकारिणी

meaning.en: goddess Sita should be understood as root-nature
meaning.hi: सीता भगवती मूल-प्रकृति-संज्ञित जानने योग्य

words.sanskrit: pranavatvat prakritih iti vadanti brahmavadinah iti athatah brahma-jijnasa iti cha

meaning.en: as Om's essence, knowers of Brahman call her nature; hence, the inquiry into Brahman begins
meaning.hi: प्रणव-रूप होने से प्रकृति कहलाती है; अतः ब्रह्म-जिज्ञासा

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: she is made of every Veda, every deity, every world
meaning.hi: वह सर्व-वेद-मयी, सर्व-देव-मयी, सर्व-लोक-मयी

meaning.en: she is every glory, every duty, the foundation of cause and effect
meaning.hi: सर्व-कीर्ति, सर्व-धर्म, कार्य-कारण-मयी

meaning.en: she is Mahalakshmi, both distinct and never separate from the Lord of gods
meaning.hi: महालक्ष्मी, देवेश से भिन्न-अभिन्न रूपा

meaning.en: the self of conscious and unconscious, of Brahman and unmoving earth alike
meaning.hi: चेतन-अचेतन आत्मा, ब्रह्म-स्थावर आत्मा

meaning.en: she takes forms from sages and humans to demons, spirits, and ghosts
meaning.hi: देवर्षि-मनुष्य-गंधर्व से असुर-राक्षस-भूत-प्रेत रूपा

meaning.en: she is known as the elements, senses, mind, and breath
meaning.hi: भूत-इन्द्रिय-मन-प्राण रूपा जानी जाती है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: sa devi trividha bhavati shaktya sana ichchha-shaktih kriya-shaktih sakshat-shaktih iti

meaning.en: this goddess is threefold: will, action, and the power that simply is
meaning.hi: देवी त्रिविध: इच्छाशक्ति, क्रियाशक्ति, साक्षात्शक्ति

meaning.en: her will-power is itself threefold
meaning.hi: इच्छाशक्ति स्वयं त्रिविध

meaning.en: she appears as Shri, Bhumi, Nila, auspicious, radiant, through moon, sun, fire
meaning.hi: श्री-भूमि-नीला रूप, चंद्र-सूर्य-अग्नि से प्रकट

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: in lunar form she gives rise to herbs, the wish-tree, flowers, fruit, vines, shrubs
meaning.hi: सोमरूपा औषधि, कल्पवृक्ष, पुष्प-फल-लता उत्पन्न करती

words.sanskrit: amrita-rupa devanam mahastoma-phalaprada amritena triptim janayanti

meaning.en: in nectar-form she satisfies the gods with the fruit of great sacrifices
meaning.hi: अमृतरूपा देवों को यज्ञफल-तृप्ति देती

meaning.en: she feeds humans with food, animals with grass, each creature its own way
meaning.hi: मनुष्यों को अन्न, पशुओं को तृण से पोषित करती

meaning.en: she turns the whole cycle of time endlessly, like a wheel
meaning.hi: कालचक्र को पहिये-सा अंतहीन घुमाती

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: in fire-form she is hunger and thirst of creatures, the mouth through which gods take offerings
meaning.hi: अग्निरूपा, प्राणियों की क्षुधा-तृष्णा, देवमुख

words.sanskrit: shri-devi trividham rupam kritva loka-rakshana-artham rupam dharayati

meaning.en: goddess Shri, taking three forms, wears whatever shape protects the world
meaning.hi: श्रीदेवी त्रिविध रूप धरकर लोकरक्षा करती

words.sanskrit: bhudevi sasagaram-bhah saptadvipa vasundhara chaturdasha-bhuvananam adhara-adheya pranava-atmika bhavati

meaning.en: as Bhudevi, earth ringed by oceans and seven islands, support of fourteen worlds, carrying Om's essence
meaning.hi: भूदेवी सप्तद्वीपा, चतुर्दश भुवनों का आधार, प्रणवात्मिका

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: nila cha mukha-vidyun-malini sarva-aushadhinam sarva-praninam poshana-artham sarva-rupa bhavati

meaning.en: the dark, lightning-garlanded one takes countless forms to nourish every plant and creature
meaning.hi: नीला, विद्युन्माला-मुखी, सर्व-पोषण हेतु सर्वरूपा

words.sanskrit: samasta-bhuvanasya adho-bhage jala-akara-atmika mandukamayi iti bhuvana-adhara iti vijnayate

meaning.en: in the lowest region she is water itself, known as the frog-like support of all worlds
meaning.hi: सब लोकों के नीचे जलाकारा, भुवनाधार मंडूकमयी

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: her power of action takes shape as sound from Hari's mouth
meaning.hi: क्रियाशक्ति हरि के मुख से उठती नाद

meaning.en: from sound comes the point, from the point comes Om
meaning.hi: नाद से बिंदु, बिंदु से ओंकार

meaning.en: beyond Om lies Rama's mountain of ascetic dwelling
meaning.hi: ओंकार से परे राम का वैखानस पर्वत

meaning.en: on that mountain grow many branches filled with knowledge and action
meaning.hi: उस पर्वत पर कर्म-ज्ञानमयी शाखाएँ

meaning.en: there the threefold scripture is found in original, complete form
meaning.hi: वहाँ त्रयीमय शास्त्र, सर्वार्थदर्शन

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: made of Rig, Yajur, Sama, it is called threefold knowledge
meaning.hi: ऋक्-यजुः-सामरूप होने से त्रयी कहलाती

meaning.en: by purpose it divides into four applications
meaning.hi: प्रयोजन से चार भेद

meaning.en: the Rig, Yajur, Sama, and Atharvangirasa unfold in turn
meaning.hi: ऋक्, यजुः, साम, अथर्वांगिरस क्रमशः

words.sanskrit: ekavimshati-shakhayam rigvedah parikirtitah shatam cha nava-shakhasu yajusham eva janmanam

meaning.en: the Rig Veda spans twenty-one branches, Yajur's hundred belong to their own lineage
meaning.hi: ऋग्वेद इक्कीस शाखा, यजुर्वेद सौ शाखा

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: the Sama Veda has a thousand branches, Atharva Veda five
meaning.hi: सामवेद सहस्र शाखा, अथर्ववेद पाँच शाखा

meaning.en: the Vaikhanasa school rests on direct perception at its origin
meaning.hi: वैखानस मत प्रत्यक्ष-दर्शन पर आधारित

meaning.en: sages remember this teaching, beyond the Vaikhanasa system itself
meaning.hi: मुनि इसे नित्य स्मरण करते, वैखानस से परे

words.sanskrit: kalpo vyakaranam shiksha niruktam jyotisham chhandah etani shad-angani

meaning.en: ritual, grammar, pronunciation, etymology, astronomy, meter are the six limbs
meaning.hi: कल्प, व्याकरण, शिक्षा, निरुक्त, ज्योतिष, छंद - षडंग

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: auxiliary sciences of practice, and traditions of reasoning and logic
meaning.hi: उपांग, मीमांसा-न्याय का विस्तार

meaning.en: the deeper knowledge of the righteous, and learning built on the Vedas
meaning.hi: धर्मज्ञ-सेवित अर्थ, वेद-आधारित विद्या

meaning.en: treatises, every branch, and the customs a community follows
meaning.hi: निबंध, सभी शाखा, समयाचार-संगति

meaning.en: this forms the treatise on righteous conduct, held in the sages' innermost heart
meaning.hi: धर्मशास्त्र महर्षियों के अंतःकरण में संभृत

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: history and the great narrative traditions are counted as auxiliary knowledge
meaning.hi: इतिहास-पुराण उपांग में गिने जाते

words.sanskrit: vastu-vedah dhanurvedah gandharvah cha tatha mune ayurvedah cha panchaite upavedah prakirtitah

meaning.en: architecture, archery, music, and medicine are the five auxiliary Vedas, O sage
meaning.hi: वास्तु, धनुर्वेद, गांधर्व, आयुर्वेद - पाँच उपवेद

words.sanskrit: dandah nitih cha varta cha vidya vayu-jayah parah

meaning.en: discipline, governance, livelihood, and beyond, mastery over the breath is the highest
meaning.hi: दंड, नीति, वार्ता, और परम विद्या वायुजय

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: this self-luminous teaching has twenty-one distinct aspects
meaning.hi: यह स्वप्रकाश इक्कीस भेदों वाला बताया गया

meaning.en: long ago Vishnu's voice arose before the sage Vaikhanasa
meaning.hi: वैखानस ऋषि से पूर्व विष्णु-वाणी उत्पन्न

meaning.en: conceived as the threefold Vedic knowledge, by that sage in ancient times
meaning.hi: त्रयीरूप में संकल्पित, वैखानस ऋषि द्वारा प्राचीन काल में

words.sanskrit: udito yadrishah purvam tadrisham shrinu me akhilam

meaning.en: just as it was originally spoken, listen now as I relate it
meaning.hi: जैसा पूर्व में कहा गया, वैसा ही सुनो

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: that eternal form, filled with Brahman, is called her power of action
meaning.hi: सनातन ब्रह्ममय रूप क्रियाशक्ति कही जाती

meaning.en: the very power of Bhagavan, arising the instant he is remembered
meaning.hi: भगवान की शक्ति, स्मरण मात्र से प्रकट

meaning.en: restraining and blessing, always beside Bhagavan, never departing
meaning.hi: निग्रह-अनुग्रह रूपा, भगवत्सहचारिणी

meaning.en: rising and settling like a blink, source of creation, sustaining, dissolving, withdrawal, grace
meaning.hi: निमेष-उन्मेष सृष्टि-स्थिति-संहार-अनुग्रह की शक्ति

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: ichchha-shaktih trividha pralaya-avasthayam vishramanartham bhagavatah dakshina-vakshahsthale shrivatsa-akritih bhutva vishramyati iti sa yoga-shaktih

meaning.en: her will-power, resting during dissolution on Bhagavan's chest, is her power of yogic union
meaning.hi: इच्छाशक्ति महाप्रलय में भगवान की छाती पर विश्राम करती, यह योगशक्ति

meaning.en: her power of enjoyment rests in the wish-tree, wish-cow, gem, and treasures of abundance
meaning.hi: भोगशक्ति कल्पवृक्ष-कामधेनु-चिंतामणि आदि नवनिधि में

words.sanskrit: bhagavad-upasakanam kamanaya akamanaya va bhaktiyukta naram nitya-naimittika-karmabhih agnihotra-adibhih va yama-niyama-asana-pranayama-pratyahara-dhyana-dharana-samadhibhih

meaning.en: devotees express it through daily duties, fire rites, and yogic disciplines
meaning.hi: भक्त इसे नित्यकर्म, अग्निहोत्र, यम-नियम-आसन-प्राणायाम से व्यक्त करते

words.sanskrit: gopura-prakara-adibhih vimana-adibhih saha bhagavad-vigraha-archa-puja-upakaranaih archanaih snana-adi-parva pitri-puja-adibhih anna-pana-adibhih va bhagavat-pritya-artham uktva sarvam kriyate

meaning.en: and through temple building, worship, bathing rites, ancestor honor, and offerings of food, all for Bhagavan's pleasure
meaning.hi: मंदिर-निर्माण, पूजा, स्नान, पितृपूजा, अन्नदान सब भगवत्प्रीति हेतु

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: athato vira-shaktih chaturbhuja abhaya-varada-padma-dhara kirita-abharana-yuta sarva-devaih parivrita

meaning.en: now her heroic power: four-armed, holding a lotus, offering fearlessness and blessing, crowned, surrounded by all deities
meaning.hi: वीरशक्ति: चतुर्भुज, अभय-वरद-पद्मधारी, सर्वदेव-परिवृत

words.sanskrit: kalpataru-mule chaturbhih gajaih ratnaghataih amritajalaih abhishichyamana

meaning.en: seated at the wish-tree's base, bathed by four elephants with jeweled vessels of nectar
meaning.hi: कल्पतरु-मूल में चार गजों द्वारा अमृत-अभिषिक्त

words.sanskrit: sarva-devataih brahma-adibhih vandyamana animadi-ashta-aishvarya-yuta sammukhe kamadhenuna stuyamana

meaning.en: honored by Brahma and all gods, endowed with eight great powers, praised by the wish-cow
meaning.hi: ब्रह्मादि द्वारा वंदित, अष्टैश्वर्ययुत, कामधेनु द्वारा स्तुत

meaning.en: seated on a divine throne, cross-legged on a lotus, cause of every cause and effect, Lakshmi herself
meaning.hi: दिव्य सिंहासन पर पद्मासनारूढ़, सकल कारण-कार्यकारी लक्ष्मी

words.sanskrit: sthira prasanna-lochana sarva-devataih pujyamana vira-lakshmih iti vijnayate iti upanishat

meaning.en: steady, gentle-eyed, worshipped by all deities, known as Vira Lakshmi; so ends this Upanishad
meaning.hi: स्थिर, प्रसन्न-नेत्रा, वीरलक्ष्मी; यहाँ उपनिषद् समाप्त

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.
